data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but cuts remaining stock by8 and the low-recovery stock by16. This assumes those catches; other choices need recalculation. Intentions aren't binding; long-run gains aren't assured. Each: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
